# Exchange offline completion now sends local storage failures to its completion callback

The 1926 MessageFetchListener chains local rv values but finally calls OnDownloadFinished(status), so a local failure does not replace the original network status there. Current MsgFetcher chains FinishNewMessage, header lookup, storeToken, offline size and Offline flag, then assigns status=rv before deciding whether to continue or call mDoneFn. This is a historical data-flow weakness and a current safer pattern, not a reproduced failure or a verified explanation from review. The current size-versus-server-size rule is already saved separately. Scoped manual proposal for terminal callbacks: avoid ordinary early-return macros across required cleanup and completion; accumulate the final status, release per-message state and notify completion. This is static source inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Exchange local completion result.
